title: 21st.dev Component Library Integration
summary: Rules and patterns for integrating 21st.dev production-ready React components into projects, including component discovery, customization, animation patterns, and best practices.
instructions: 21st.dev provides production-ready React components with built-in Framer Motion animations — prefer over hand-rolling common UI patterns.
ComponentArray import: use dynamic import pattern for loading 21st.dev components. Components support className prop for styling.
Component discovery: search 21st.dev for landing page sections (hero, features, pricing, testimonials, FAQ, CTA, stats, logos, contact).
Animation integration: 21st.dev components use Framer Motion internally. Wrap sections in AnimatePresence when needed for staggered reveals.
Customization: override default styles via className prop. Components use Tailwind CSS classes. Avoid modifying component internals.
Dark mode: 21st.dev components support dark mode via parent dark class. Test in both modes after integration.
Landing pages: use pre-built section components (HeroSection, FeaturesGrid, PricingTable, TestimonialsCarousel) for rapid prototyping.
Animation variants: 21st.dev components accept animation variant props for customizing enter/exit behavior.
Bundle optimization: tree-shake unused components at build time. Import only what's needed per page.
DO NOT: re-implement 21st.dev components from scratch — always import and customize via props/className.
DO NOT: wrap 21st.dev components in unnecessary motion.div layers — they already handle their own animations.
When combining with Three.js: place 21st.dev sections below the 3D hero, connected via shared color/typography tokens.
evidenceRequirements: Whether 21st.dev is already installed or needs to be added
Target page type (landing, dashboard, pricing, etc.)
Existing Tailwind CSS configuration and theme tokens
